objectives.description: Sources and prevention of hazards: concept of safety; sources of hazards; treatments including electric shock, damp or wet floor, wrong handling of tools, improper workshop dressing, horse play in the workshop.
Safety checks in servicing radio receiver: preparation of work areas; capacitor discharges; working on power lines and live circuits; handling of tools.
Safety precautions in television workshop: power supplies in TV; picture tube; high voltage section; component rating.
Structure of matter; conductors, insulators and semiconductors; current, voltage and resistance — definition, units and symbols; laws of attraction and repulsion of charges.

Electronic components: identification by name, type, graphical symbol, value and rating — resistors, capacitors, inductors, diodes, transformers, transistors, integrated circuit; colour code for resistors and capacitors; testing of capacitors.

Kirchhoff's Current and Voltage Laws: concepts, definitions and calculations; Ohm's Law; electric power; direct and alternating current; alternating waveform (r.m.s., peak, average values, frequency and period).
Diodes and Transistors: types, graphical symbols and structure; testing for diodes and transistor configurations (CC, CE and CB). Battery: types, testing, difference between wet and dry cells.

subStrands.name: Hand Tools, Measuring Instruments and Fault Finding Equipment

objectives.description: Electronic hand tools: types and uses — screw drivers, diagonal cutters, soldering gun, soldering iron, lead sucker, pocket knife, stripper, soldering wick.
Electronic measuring instruments: identification, uses and operation — voltmeter, ammeter, ohmmeter, multimeter; basic AC and DC circuit measurements; testing semiconductor devices.
Fault finding equipment: identification, uses and operation — oscilloscope, signal tracer, digital frequency counter, logic probe, TV analyser.

subStrands.name: Emission, Semiconductors, Power Supply, Amplifiers, Feedback and Oscillators

objectives.description: Meaning of electronics and electronic circuit; concept of emission and photoelectric devices — types of emission (thermionic, photoelectric, field and secondary).

Semiconductor theory; semiconductor diodes — rectification, principles of operation, characteristics and application; power supply unit — rectification types, filters, construction of stabilized low DC power supply.
Amplifiers: operation and construction of Class A, B, C and AB amplifiers; RLC circuits (quantitative treatments only).

Feedback: concept; types; effect of positive feedback on bandwidth, noise, gain and distortion. Oscillators and Multivibrators: principles, types, construction; types of multivibrator (astable, bistable, monostable).

subStrands.name: Communication Systems, Modulation, Radio/TV Transmitters and Receivers

objectives.description: Electronic communication systems: definition, types; noise; electromagnetic spectrum — classification, propagation of radio waves, radio frequency bands (VLF, LF, MF, HF, VHF, UHF, SHF, EHF) and their applications.
Transducers: definition, types and functions — loudspeaker, microphone, video camera, CRT/LCD.
Modulation and demodulation: definition, principles and types; AM and FM waveforms; percentage of modulation, modulation index; carrier wave function; types of demodulation.

Radio transmitter and receiver: function and operation; block diagram of TRF and superheterodyne receivers (FM and AM); advantages and disadvantages. Selectivity and sensitivity. Resonant circuit: types (series and parallel), bandwidth, resonant frequency.

Satellite communication systems: elements, types, transmission and reception, antenna. Television transmitter: working principle and block diagram. Image and sound reproduction in TV receiver: principle of scanning, colour TV principles.

Maintenance and repair of radio receivers: fault diagnosis procedures; alignment of RF and IF stages; use of multimeter; measurement of current, voltage and resistance in active and passive components.

Maintenance and repair of TV receivers: procedures for TV repairs; use of service manual and circuit diagram; identification of symptoms and repair of faults; fault clearing instruments; static and dynamic colour convergence; colour bar generator.
Business Management and Finance: accounting practices; cost benefit analysis; purchasing method; business records (ledger, repair order form, inventory sheet); sources of capital.

Customer Relations and Business Opportunities: customer psychology, telephone courtesy, working relations; business opportunities — satellite installation, electronic specialist, radio and TV consultant/technician, sales and service craftsman, antenna and TV installation work.
